rows.text: Sam Okafor (Riya's partner) is vegetarian, which also means no fish or seafood (not pescatarian).
Sam Okafor's birthday is March 22; he prefers a quiet dinner at home over a restaurant party, so never plan him a big event.
Riya runs with Marcus Bell on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 6:30 am along the Martin Goodman Trail, so those early mornings are unavailable.
Tom Becker is Riya's manager (VP Product at Lumen Pay). He reads everything on his phone between meetings and hates long threads: keep emails to Tom under 5 sentences with the ask in the first line.
Aisha Rahman is the engineering lead on Riya's team. She prefers async Slack threads over meetings and wants specs at least two weeks before sprint planning.
Team standup is Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays at 9:45. Tuesday mornings (09:00-12:00) are Riya's no-meeting focus block; Payments guild sync series was declined.
Priya Nair is Riya's best friend, from McGill; she is an architect now living in Montreal.
Riya's car, a Mazda CX-5, is insured with Intact Insurance and renews each April; remind her in March.
Riya has a Spanish lesson with Carlos every Tuesday at 19:00.
Riya's household: partner Sam, son Leo (6, turning 7 in the fall), and Biscuit, a beagle born around April 2022 who is food-motivated and steals bread off the counter; do not leave bread out.
Kabir Malhotra is Riya's younger brother, a software engineer at a game studio in Vancouver, married to Mei Malhotra.
Riya works in the Lumen Pay office on King Street West on Tuesdays and Thursdays and from home the rest of the week.
Rule: ask Riya before any purchase over $100. No exceptions.
Rule: do not text Sam's parents (Grace and Daniel Okafor) on Riya's behalf.
Flight preferences: WestJet first, aisle seat, never basic economy.
Always show prices in CAD; convert any foreign currency and put the original in brackets, e.g. CA$137 (US$100).

Hannah Cho is Riya's neighbour two doors down (added to contacts by Sam). She is a nurse at Michael Garron Hospital with some night shifts, so text before calling in daytime. Her kids are Ellie (10) and Jun (7). Mobile +1 416-555-0193.
Riya takes levothyroxine 50 mcg every morning for hypothyroidism, 30 minutes before coffee; daily reminder at 06:45.
Riya and Sam met in 2015 at a friend's board-game night; wedding/anniversary treated as June 8 (this is later corrected).
Sam Okafor teaches grade 11 and 12 chemistry at Riverdale Collegiate Institute; Sunday evenings he is often marking lab reports, so plan dates with Sam on Saturdays, not Sundays.

House: basement floods slightly near the back wall in heavy spring rain (only that strip). Sump pump replaced May 2024 (Zoeller M53, $640). Furnace serviced 2023-09 (Reliance); eavestroughs cleaned 2024-10.
Kitchen reno is by Northline Renovations (contact Nate); deposit #2 of $8,500 was scheduled from TD joint chequing on 2025-07-24; cabinet install is Sat 2025-08-23 (all day). Nate prefers email.
Rule: never send an email on Riya's behalf without showing her the draft first, even a tiny one.
Riya's dentist is Dr. Lin at Queen East Dental, 1046 Queen St E.
Riya loves South Indian food, especially masala dosa; her favourite local spot is Saffron Lane on Queen Street East.
Format meeting summaries as three sections: Decisions, Action items (with owner and date), Open questions.
Date format: in chat write like 'Mon 19 Oct'; in work documents use ISO format like 2026-10-19.
Calendar invites Riya's agent creates must state the time in Toronto time, and also in IST if Riya's mother in Mumbai is invited.
Leo goes to bed at 7:45 pm on school nights: nothing after dinner on weeknights once school is back. Leo does not do well with sleepovers yet; decline politely if anyone asks.
Riya's 1:1 with Tom Becker is weekly on Thursdays at 14:00.

Wen Li is the data analyst Riya works with. Data requests go through the #data-requests Slack channel with at least three business days of notice and a written metric definition, otherwise Wen bounces them.
Flight preferences beyond airline: prefer direct flights even if up to $300 more, aisle seat, and avoid red-eyes unless the arrival is in the morning.

Plan: Kabir wants Riya's family in Vancouver in the fall; Thanksgiving trip YYZ-YVR considered for Fri 2025-10-10 to Mon 2025-10-13 for 3 (2 adults + child). Nothing held; fare watch active. Flair via Calgary $1,128 (cheapest), WestJet $1,402 (red-eye return), Air Canada $1,596, WestJet midday $1,689.
Riya runs with Marcus Bell on Saturdays at 7:00 am, a 10 km loop along the Martin Goodman Trail starting at Woodbine Beach (standing weekly event since 2025-07-19).
Riya plans to sit the DELE B2 Spanish exam in May 2026; registration for the May 2026 session opens in February 2026 (Instituto Cervantes, Toronto centres).
Lumen Pay tool stack: Linear for tickets, Slack for chat, Notion for docs, Figma for design, Looker for metrics, Google Workspace for mail and calendar.
Home internet is Bell Fibe at $95 a month.

Payouts v2 PRD lives in Notion, created from the team's PRD-v3 template (one-page summary, Requirements, Design, Rollout, Decision log); dates in ISO. PRD drafts also include a Non-goals section and an Open questions table with owner and due-date columns.

Commitment: Aisha needs the payouts v2 spec by Aug 25 for the Sep 8 sprint; on 2025-07-25 Riya told Aisha by email the spec will be in Notion by 2025-08-18, with open questions on ledger reconciliation flagged at the top.
Recurring finances: mortgage with TD (biweekly); RESP for Leo $208/month at TD (full CESG grant, 20% up to $500/yr); Spotify family and Netflix; monthly e-transfer to Carlos (Spanish tutor).
Sam's parents are Grace and Daniel Okafor, who live in Alta Vista, Ottawa. Daniel is a retired civil engineer who will have opinions about the reno; Grace still teaches piano.
Plan: weekend of 16-17 Aug 2025 with Sam's parents Grace and Daniel Okafor; dinner Sat 2025-08-16 19:00 at Ascari Enoteca (Queen St E), party of 5, ref ASC-4471.

Olivia Grant is Director of Sales Enablement at Lumen Pay and often asks Riya for feature dates to share with prospects. Never give Olivia or anyone in sales a feature date until Aisha Rahman has signed off; drafts to Olivia say 'target', not 'launch date'.
When Riya writes in Spanish, reply in Spanish and correct every mistake inline. She wants to practise Spanish with the agent sometimes.
Riya's banking: TD joint chequing with Sam is the household bills account; her own savings are in EQ Bank and must not be touched. Also a TD Visa.
Riya calls her mother Anjali every Sunday at 9:00 am Toronto time (6:30 pm Mumbai); keep that slot clear (later corrected).

Spanish learning: Carlos's intake notes say Riya learns best through role-play of real situations (ordering food, work meeting, doctor's visit) and wants Mexican vocabulary (carro, computadora) rather than Castilian. Weak spots: ser/estar, preterite vs imperfect, gender of -ma nouns, subjunctive after 'cuando'. Level B1 working toward B2; goal is an hour-long conversation without English by the 2027 trip to Mexico City.
Marcus Bell is Riya's friend from a running club, a physiotherapist training for the Chicago Marathon; he often pushes longer runs (e.g. 16k).
Biscuit's vet is Dr. Moreau at Leslieville Animal Hospital on Queen Street East.
Riya dislikes cilantro: leave it out of recipes and food orders, always.
Style: when Riya asks something, give the answer first, then bullet points; no preamble, do not restate her question.
Calendar rule: never book meetings for Riya before 9:30 or after 17:00.
Biscuit walks (agreed with Sam, July 2025): Riya walks him every morning at 6:30 am (Leslie Street Spit loop on weekends, around the block on weekdays); Sam does the 9:00 pm walk.
Health (private): Riya is allergic to penicillin (hives) and has seasonal allergies in May managed with Reactine. Mention the penicillin allergy whenever a doctor or pharmacy comes up.
Riya Malhotra is a Senior Product Manager at Lumen Pay (started 2024-02-05), owning Merchant payouts and Merchant onboarding; manager Tom Becker.
Riya's usual coffee order is an oat milk latte.
Diego Fernández is the designer on Riya's team. Give him feedback as Figma comments, not DMs, and frame it as a problem statement rather than a proposed solution.
Riya does a 6:00 am spin class at Spin Society on Queen Street East every Wednesday (class may shift to 6:15 on occasion).
Use Canadian spelling in everything written for Riya (colour, centre, cheque, organize).
Idea: go to the Canadian Tulip Festival in Ottawa in May 2026 with Sam's parents (they did not go in 2025); check dates in April.
Carlos Méndez is Riya's online Spanish tutor from Guadalajara (lessons on Zoom). Riya pays monthly by Interac e-transfer, $180 CAD for four lessons (carlos.mendez.es@example.com).
Spanish vocabulary lists go in a table: Spanish, English, example sentence (Riya studies them in Anki).
Riya's work email style: warm but brief, no exclamation marks, signed 'Best, Riya'.
Always give temperatures in both Celsius and Fahrenheit (Daniel Okafor only thinks in Fahrenheit).
Leo is allergic to tree nuts: the family keeps all nuts out of his lunches, no exceptions, even if camp or school says it is nut-aware.
Hotel rule: only fully refundable rates, ideally within walking distance of transit.
Plan: Riya visits Priya Nair in Montreal Fri 2025-09-12 to Sun 2025-09-14; Hôtel Monville booked, fully refundable until 2025-09-10 ($548.70, confirmation MV-88213).

Anjali Malhotra is Riya's mother, living in Bandra, Mumbai; retired school principal with type 2 diabetes, so gifts and sweets must be sugar-free. Riya sends a rakhi box each early August (ships about 7 days to Mumbai).

Riya and Sam's anniversary is June 16 (married 2018-06-16; met 2015-06-16). They usually go out for dinner without Leo, so a sitter is needed; dinner Tue 2026-06-16 for 2, restaurant reservations for June 2026 open in April 2026. Shortlist: Edulis, Ascari Enoteca, Planta Queen (vegetarian-friendly). Sitter candidates: Maya R. ($20/h), Josie T. ($22/h), Ana P. ($17/h).
Sam drinks oat-milk flat whites and dislikes anything hazelnut-flavoured.
In the PRD and Riya's work writing: use 'use' instead of 'leverage'; Tom Becker also flags 'synergy', 'north star', 'low-hanging fruit', 'utilize'. Avoid that jargon.
Team practice: disagree and commit; every product decision goes into the Notion decision log within 24 hours.

Riya's video call with her mother Anjali is every Sunday at 9:00 pm Toronto time (6:30 am Monday in Mumbai, before her morning walk); not the morning, since Anjali is at the temple then. Keep the slot clear.
Kabir Malhotra's birthday is August 5. Riya and Kabir do not give real gifts; they swap silly novelty mugs as a tradition.
Riya does not want a play-by-play narration of steps; just show the results/options when they come in.
Restaurant booking rule: book for 19:00 and check there are good vegetarian options, every time.
Leo's school year at Morse Street PS: first day Tue 2025-09-02; class list posts Thu 2025-08-28; before/after care registration closes Fri 2025-08-15.
Fare watch placed for YYZ-YVR Oct 10-13 2025, 3 travellers (reports any drop over $100); Thanksgiving fares usually rise after early September. Riya said not to hold any flight yet.
Biscuit eats only Purina Pro Plan Sensitive Skin & Stomach, Salmon & Rice (13.6 kg, ordered from Pet Valu); no chicken-based food, which gave him itchy skin. Check listings are not another flavour.
Riya does 15 minutes of Spanish Anki cards every weekday morning (on the streetcar).
Rule (verbatim from Riya): when the agent schedules a work meeting for Riya, it defaults to 25 minutes and always puts an agenda in the invite. Riya declines meetings with no agenda.
Property tax is paid by pre-authorized debit from the TD joint account (****4471): $612.40 on 2025-09-02, 2025-10-01 and 2025-11-03. No action needed.
Green bin and recycling go out Wednesdays at 19:00, before Leo's bedtime routine at 19:45.

Family birthdays: Sam March 22, Leo October 21 (turning 7 in 2025), Kabir August 5. Riya wants all family birthdays yearly in the calendar with a reminder a week before; dates still missing for Anjali, Mei, Grace Okafor, Daniel Okafor (ask Riya).
